newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.

text.p: 1230 GMT - Hungary's forint ended Friday trade firmer against the dollar as it followed the dollar/mark, dealers said.
* The forint closed at 177.59/64 to one dollar after opening at 177.85/90.
* The unit was steady against the currency basket, with the gap from the NBH resistance level remaining at 25-30 pips.
* Dealers said trade was active towards the end of the session as the dollar fell back, with traders looking for dollar bids.
